//: Scopes Deno to this directory. Without it, Deno walks up, finds the app's
package.json and treats the whole frontend as an npm project — so
`deno check` on a function that imports only deno.land, jsr: and relative
paths would download chai, tapable, lightningcss and the rest of the Vite
That is not merely slow. It made CI fail on 2026-08-20 for a reason with
nothing to do with this code: Deno refuses npm packages published in the
last 24 hours (the minimum-dependency-age supply-chain guard), and a
@rolldown binary in Vite 8's tree had just been released. Every npm release
anywhere in the frontend tree was a coin flip on the Edge Function step.
These functions have no npm dependencies. This file keeps it that way.
